_meta.purpose: Lines-per-ode for Pindar's four victory-ode books. Same role as homer_line_counts.json: reject citations past an ode's real end (a stray at line 813 in the 115-line Pythian 3, or 701 in the 70-line Isthmian 8) before they are fanned out. Without it, locus._expand_bookline only checks ode<=14 and line>=1, so any line within a valid ode number passes.
_meta.numbering: Snell-Maehler line counts. Index = ode - 1. Values are approximate to a few lines; the resolver applies a small margin.
_meta.note: Pythian 4 (299 lines) is genuinely the longest ode; the rest are ~20-130 lines.
